decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 15/01/08, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring 5.7m in width, 4.2m in depth and 2.9m in height was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Informatives:
1		The extension hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 29 North Hyde Lane, and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a separate dwelling or bed-sit and should not include kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension with new ground floor window to side of house
